baseline.availability_status: ASSUMPTION: selected screening results known before evaluation; actual result times unknown
baseline.source_row_convention: 1-based data row, excludes header; no synthetic EHR
baseline.unit_resolution: HbA1c operational percent follows paper Methods group definitions, despite dictionary mmol/mol conflict; no numerical conversion

inner.assignment: sorted outer-training IDs round-robin modulo 3; no random windows

evaluation.test_retuning: forbidden; report worse fusion honestly; no Stage 2 predictions
evaluation.uncertainty: paired participant bootstrap of per-person deltas, seed 20261015, 2000 resamples; exploratory with n=14

event.independence: operational observed recovery only; not statistical independence
event.negative_requirement: all future cells (t,t+44] valid, no confirmed qualifying onset
event.unknown_policy: censor if no known positive and any future cell required by conservative 44-minute observation policy unavailable

features.slope_formula: OLS slope sum((x-xbar)*(g-gbar))/sum((x-xbar)^2); x elapsed minutes; mg/dL/min

freeze_type: versioned local checkpoint; not external preregistration
issue_grid_anchor: first parsed participant timestamp, not first valid glucose; five-minute sampling is not native-observation recovery

personalization.later_adapter: single median residual offset on calibration labels from an otherwise participant-excluded frozen base model; do not fit now

population.eligibility: finite in-source-range baseline and at least one complete-history/valid-exact-target origin
population.rule: A1c PDL (Lab) > 6.4, operational percent per original paper; no independent clinical diagnosis inferred

stage3_methods.budget_symmetry: same 4 ridge and 4 boosting candidates, same inner folds and paired origins for each variant
stage3_methods.prediction_bounds: unbounded for all methods; record out-of-range predictions later, never clip to target range

ridge.scaler: StandardScaler fit only inner-training; refit only outer-training after selection

stage3_methods.tie_break: candidate order in config; exact mean MAE ties pick earliest

status.commercial_reuse: not cleared under audited NC grant; discrepancy unresolved
status.local_retrospective_preparation: permitted noncommercial local preparation under recorded scope; purpose must remain consistent

timestamps.nonmonotonic: reject participant input; no silent sorting
timestamps.timezone: unknown; preserve shifted naive event times
